jobs.employer_name: Babaji Shivram Shipping and Logistics B.V.
jobs.description:
We are looking for someone who is hands-on, commercially aware and comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment.

4to 6 years of experience in freight forwarding, logistics, shipping, transport or supply-chain operations.
Strong understanding of international freight and export/import processes.
Existing network of freight forwarders, carriers, transporters, customs brokers or logistics service providers.
Strong coordination and communication skills.
Good understanding of logistics documentation and shipment processes.
Strong Excel / Microsoft Office skills.
Excellent written and verbal Dutch & English.
Experience in the Rotterdam / Netherlands logistics market.
Knowledge of European customs procedures.

About the Opportunity: 
We are building our European operations from the ground up with Rotterdam as our base in the Netherlands. We are looking for an ambitious and hands-on Export Pricing & Operations Coordinator to join us at this exciting stage. 

You will be one of the first people on the ground.

You will work closely and directly with the management team to help establish our logistics operations in the Netherlands, from identifying and onboarding vendors, building relationships with freight partners to developing pricing, coordinating shipments, establishing processes and supporting customer requirements.

About The Company: 
We are an established global logistics and supply-chain organisation with extensive experience across freight forwarding, customs clearance, transportation, warehousing and international supply-chain solutions. We have offices across the globe - US, China, Dubai, Oman, Saudi, Singapore, Canada and 22 offices within India. 

As part of our international expansion, we are now establishing our European presence from Rotterdam.

Our ambition is to develop the Netherlands into an important operational and commercial hub for our European activities and build a strong, reliable network across Europe.

Are you looking for an active and varied job in logistics? DHL Supply Chain in Beringe is looking for enthusiastic warehouse operators who are ready to roll up their sleeves. Whether you have experience with an EPT, OPT, reach truck, or forklift, we have various opportunities available within our modern distribution center.

Together with a dedicated team, you will ensure that all logistics processes run smoothly. No two days are the same. You will work with a variety of products, orders, and logistics activities, making your job both challenging and diverse. Experience is a plus, but it is certainly not required. With the right motivation, we are happy to teach you the rest.

Depending on your experience and preferences, your responsibilities may include:

- Picking orders using an EPT, OPT, forklift, and/or reach truck.
- Moving goods throughout the warehouse.
- Loading and unloading trucks.
- Operating a reach truck and/or forklift.
- Checking goods for quality and quantity.
- Preparing orders for shipment.
- Contributing to a safe, efficient, and well-organized warehouse environment.

You will work accurately, pay close attention to quality, and ensure that customers receive their orders on time.

Starting September 14, you will begin an extensive onboarding and training period on the work floor. From September 28 through October 16, you will therefore work the day shift from 08:00 to 17:00, allowing you to become familiar with all tasks and processes.

After the training period, you will work one of the following shifts:

- 08:00 - 17:00
- 11:00 - 20:00

You can choose to work a fixed shift or be available for both shifts. If you choose both, you will work on a weekly rotating schedule.

- Good command of Dutch and/or English.
- Experience in logistics.
- Proficiency in working with computer systems and Microsoft Excel.
- A flexible and motivated attitude.
- Own transportation.
- A valid EPT, OPT, and/or reach truck certificate is an advantag

As a logistic employee, you will work in a warehouse and start in the Value Added Services (VAS) department. Your tasks include checking goods, loading and unloading containers, and applying stickers to products. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that all products are processed correctly.

This is a full-time position from Monday to Friday, working the day shift from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. On your first working day, you will work from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM and be paired with a buddy who will guide you through all tasks and procedures. From your second day onwards, your regular working hours will be 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

After approximately two months, you will move to another logistics department within the warehouse. There, you will learn new tasks and gain more variety in your work.

During busy periods, you will work in a two-shift schedule:

- 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM
- 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM

This is a varied full-time position offering the opportunity to develop your skills and grow within the logistics sector.

- You have a good command of the English language, both spoken and written;
- You are available to work full-time;
- You are willing to start in a day shift and switch to a two-shift schedule after approximately two months;
- You have experience working in a production or logistics environment.

Warehouse Operator 
Vacancy ID: 4485 | Location: Waddinxveen, Logistics Centre Rotterdam, DACHSER Netherlands B.V. | Employment: Full-time | Contract: Fixed-term | Job category: Warehousing / Order Picking; Road Transport / Freight Forwarding 
As a Transit Terminal Operator, you will work in the cross-dock warehouse at DACHSER in Waddinxveen, part of our Logistics Centre Rotterdam in the Netherlands. Together with your colleagues, you make sure that goods are loaded, unloaded and processed safely, accurately and on time. 
You will work with an electric pallet truck (EPT) and a handheld scanner. As our logistics operation runs around the clock, you may work different shifts depending on the operation and your availability. 
"Together, we make sure every shipment leaves safely and on time." 
Your main tasks are: - Loading and unloading trailers and swap bodies. - Moving pallets with an electric pallet truck (EPT). - Scanning goods with a handheld scanner. - Placing goods in the correct location in the warehouse. - Checking whether goods are properly packed. - Reporting damage or other issues to your supervisor. 
Working hours 
You work 40 hours per week. You can work different shifts, depending on the operation and your availability. 
Possible shifts include: - Morning shift - Afternoon/evening shift - Night shift 
Together, we will look at which shift works best for you. 
Who are you? - You enjoy active and physical work. - You work well with colleagues. - You work safely and accurately. - You are flexible with working hours. - You speak Dutch or English. - You are available full-time. About DACHSER 
Logistics is People Business - this vision underlines the fact that our people are the driving force behind DACHSER's success. 
Founded in 1930, our family-owned company has grown into one of the world's leading logistics service providers. Through our global logistics network, we provide intelligent logistics solutions for our customers....

As a Warehouse Operator at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you play a key role in ensuring a smooth and efficient logistics process. You will join a supportive and collaborative team where communication, flexibility, and teamwork are highly valued.

In this all-round position, you will work across multiple warehouse departments and, when required, at different Samsung SDS locations in Tilburg.  
Your responsibilities may include physically active tasks such as order picking, packing, and preparing shipments, as well as administrative duties like inspecting incoming goods, managing inventory, and processing data in warehouse management systems. This variety allows you to develop a broad range of skills while keeping your work challenging and engaging.

Flexibility is an important part of the role. You will primarily work in a two-shift schedule (morning and evening shifts), but during peak periods you may also be required to work night shifts and occasional Saturdays. 

Working hours range from 20 to 37.5 hours per week, offering flexibility while supporting the operational needs of the business.

Ready to become part of a global organization and contribute to efficient warehouse operations? We'd love to hear from you!

You enjoy staying active and thrive in an international working environment. You are reliable, flexible, and enjoy working as part of a team. You're comfortable adapting to different tasks, departments, and warehouse locations.

Requirements:

- You have your own transportation to travel to Tilburg.
- You have a good command of the English language.
- You are available to work full-time.
- You are physically fit and able to perform warehouse activities.
- You are flexible and willing to work in a three-shift schedule, including evening shifts, night shifts when required, and occasional Saturdays.
- You are a team player with a proactive attitude.
- You are willing to work across multiple departments and warehouse locations.
